manifest.name: ud-exps-q5k-downs-q6k-kq-imat-lmhead-q8
manifest.description: #138 (unsloth UD-Q4_K_M with every routed down on Q6_K by kq_imat and the output head on Q8_0: RP-KL 0.0384, 26.97 GiB) with the routed expert gate/up raised to Q5_K, also rounded by kq_imat from each expert's pinned channel energies. The routed experts then sit at V3's formats (gate/up Q5_K, downs Q6_K) while every dense projection keeps unsloth's Q8_0 bytes and the shared experts stay Q8_0; kq_imat replaces kq_rtn's per-block rounding on all 120 expert tensors. Aimed below V3's drift (0.0340) at V3's speed and about V3's memory.
